data.long_meaning: Suhaan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘su’, which means good, and ‘haan’, which means prosperous or fortunate. The name is thus a combination of the two, signifying a person who is blessed with good fortune and prosperity.

in_sanskrit.name: सुहान
in_sanskrit.long_meaning:
सु (su) - Good, Pleasant
हान (hān) - Free from, Absent
Therefore, Suhaan means 'Free from sorrow, Good, Pleasant, Happy'
